Education & Skills

Synia Scholars Fund

Scholarships for senior secondary and tertiary study.

In set-up

What it does

Funds senior secondary and tertiary study for students who have the ability but not the means. Awards are made by a selection panel against criteria we publish.

The money is held and accounted for separately from our general funds, so that donors can see exactly where their gift went.

Who it is for

Students progressing beyond basic education, including those who came to us through Train a Child. Selection is need-led first.

What success looks like

Scholars complete their course and qualify — not merely that they enrolled.

Where it operates

National in scope. Award locations follow the successful applicants' places of study.

How it is delivered

A selection panel operating against published, need-based criteria, with ring-fenced accounting.

Why it is not yet open

The Fund will not be promoted externally until a fund agreement, published need-based selection criteria, a selection panel and ring-fenced accounting are in place.

Naming a thing a Fund creates obligations, and we intend to meet them before we fundraise. An obligation we cannot yet meet is a liability rather than an asset.

Status

In set-up

Designed and being put in place, but not yet awarding or delivering.

Support this programme

Register your interest in supporting the Fund when it opens.

Donate

You can direct your gift to this programme, to a pillar, or to wherever it is most needed.

Delivery partners

No delivery partner is named for this programme yet. Where technical delivery is required we say who our partner is — and where we have not yet appointed one, we say that too.
